title: Summarise two reports of the same interview

scenario.en: Two newspapers reported the same interview differently. Your team asks you which to believe.
scenario.ar: جرنالين نقلوا نفس المقابلة بشكل مختلف. فريقك بيسألك نصدّق مين.

source: The first reported that the minister had admitted the programme was behind schedule and had refused to give a new date. The second reported that she had explained the delay, pointed out that two suppliers had failed, and promised a revised timetable within a month. Both accounts are defensible; neither is complete.

task.en: Summarise both reports, contrast how they differ, then comment with your own view.
task.ar: لخّص التقريرين، وضّح الفرق، وبعدين قول رأيك.

key_points.en: Summarise report one: admitted and refused.
Summarise report two: explained, pointed out and promised.
key_points.ar: لخّص التقرير التاني: شرحت ووضّحت ووعدت.

key_points.en: Contrast them: the reporting verbs differ, not the facts.
key_points.ar: الفرق في أفعال النقل، مش في الحقائق.

model_answer.en: To summarise both views: the first reported that she had admitted the delay and refused a new date; the second reported that she had explained it, pointed out two supplier failures and promised a timetable. Whereas the first argues guilt, the second implies reason. The key difference is the reporting verbs, not the facts. My own view is that we should read both and trust neither alone.
model_answer.ar: تلخيصًا للرأيين: الأول نقل إنها اعترفت بالتأخير ورفضت تحدد معاد؛ والتاني نقل إنها شرحت السبب ووضّحت إن موردين فشلوا ووعدت بجدول. في حين إن الأول بيقول ذنب، التاني بيوحي بسبب. الفرق الجوهري هو أفعال النقل مش الحقائق. ورأيي إننا نقرا الاتنين وماناخدش برأي واحد لوحده.
